text:
tess: quick update from the micro-bench: tested orca-lite-13b in three configs (fp16 / int6 / int4-perchannel). want routing recs for GTN + enterprise.

vikram: paste numbers pls.

tess: FP16 p50 88ms cost ~$122/1M. INT6 p50 69ms cost ~$52/1M. PC-INT4 p50 59ms cost ~$37/1M.

ana: quality deltas?

tess: weighted ROUGE-L: INT6 -0.6, PC-INT4 -1.7 vs FP16. Hotspots: "legal-citation" slice (-3.8 RL) and "tabular-numeric" EM down ~3.1%. Short-chat & summarization slices within 0.5 RL.

vikram: product asks for a low-cost default but no regressions on legal/finance. propose hybrid routing: default -> PC-INT4; predicates to route to INT6/FP16: contains citation/url regex OR token_count>320 OR numeric-table pattern OR user_tier enterprise.

ana: can we implement cheap predicate checks at edge? regex + token counters fine. maybe a tiny classifier for numeric-table detection.

ops-bot: rollout checklist:
- add config flag: quant.default=pc-int4
- implement predicates: citation_regex, num_tokens, numeric_table_detector
- metric: quant_fallback_rate and avg_unit_cost per route
- canary: 2% traffic for 72h, shadow INT6 for 5% traffic for 24h
- alert if fallback_rate>7% for >15m or complaint_rate spike

vikram: scorecard mock:
```
slice: short-chat        | FP16 RL 44.8 | PC-INT4 RL 44.4 | delta -0.4 | cost ratio 0.30
slice: legal-citation   | FP16 RL 49.2 | PC-INT4 RL 45.4 | delta -3.8 | cost ratio 0.30
slice: tabular-numeric  | FP16 EM 81.0 | PC-INT4 EM 77.9 | delta -3.1 | cost ratio 0.30
unit_cost_per_1M: FP16 $122 | INT6 $52 | PC-INT4 $37
```

ana: ML ask: run a 36h per-layer sweep (attention int6, ff int4 and vice-versa) to see where legal drop comes from. allocate 3xA100-80GB. I'll own the 100-case human eval focused on legal citations.

tess: recommendation: roll hybrid with the predicates (favored). conservative option = default INT6 (~$52/1M) for enterprise SKUs. aggressive = PC-INT4 only (cheapest ~$37/1M but higher risk).

vikram: GTN blurb draft: "orca-lite-13b delivers up to ~70% lower inference cost on typical chat workloads; automated fidelity rails ensure citation-heavy and numeric-table requests receive higher-precision models to preserve accuracy."

ops-bot: reminder set for canary review in 72h.

tess: thanks all 44d will open tickets for sweep + routing PR.
